description: This is a PHP source file for a web application page that manages editing port forwarding services. It includes PHP logic for retrieving and processing device and port mapping information, as well as client-side JavaScript for form validation, IPv6 address handling, and AJAX submission.
published: Form for editing port forwarding rules

methods.name: populateIPv6Addr
methods.description: Parses and expands compressed IPv6 addresses into an array of segments.

methods.name: IsBlank
methods.description: Checks if all input fields with a specific prefix are blank.

methods.name: GetAddress
methods.description: Concatenates IPv6 address segments with a specified separator.

methods.name: isIp6AddrRequired
methods.description: Determines if IPv6 address fields are mandatory (not all blank).

methods.name: ipv6_in_int
methods.description: Converts the first four segments of an IPv6 address into an integer array for comparison.

methods.name: isHex
methods.description: Checks if a string represents a valid hexadecimal number.

methods.name: validate_v6addr_pool
methods.description: Validates if the IPv6 address range is within the permissible pool.

methods.name: isIp4AddrRequired
methods.description: Checks if IPv4 address input is required.
